children: Hayasa reported lower copper grades than Hole UDD-021 in two Urasar holes totaling 1,052.9 m. It ended the Vardenis option and is focusing on a two-year, major-company-funded exploration alliance, subject to definitive agreements.
The reported interval is low grade, and the release says both holes returned lower copper values than the earlier UDD-021 intercept.
A narrow copper interval offers limited evidence of economic mineralization in this drilling.
Alliance phase: 2 years, solely funded by major company
Could advance exploration without Hayasa funding the alliance phase, but the term sheet is non-binding and definitive agreements remain outstanding.
Ended Vardenis option to remove carrying costs
Reduces property-related costs and redirects focus, but the release provides no amount of savings.
Three exploration licenses expected in early 2027
Potentially expands the exploration portfolio; receipt and timing remain expected, not confirmed.

This is an early-stage exploration update: the new Urasar holes returned lower copper values than the prior UDD-021 intercept, and the company says it has yet to intersect the system's mineralized core. The next catalyst is execution of definitive alliance agreements, expected before year end, followed by exploration activity and the expected early-2027 license decisions.
